description: Where to check one VIN's recall repairs. mcp.vin does not ask the manufacturer or NHTSA about a VIN: this returns links, manufacturer_lookup_url (the maker's own recall page; the VIN is filled in where vin_prefilled is true, else enter it there) and nhtsa_lookup_url (NHTSA's VIN recall page, all makes), with open_count and completed_count null: unknown, never zero. Makes without a known maker page get NHTSA's link only. For the recall campaigns of the model year use lookup_recalls or decode_vin.
name: vin_recall_status
